node.title: Re: SQLPLUS connect database
node.author: poj
node.doctext:
select sysdate from dual to prove it is up. but I cannot figure out how to do it

Try putting the SQL in a separate file.

#!perl use strict; open TMP,'>','~tmp.sql' or die "$!"; print TMP << 'END_OF_SQL'; SET HEADING OFF; SELECT systimestamp || ' IP=' || sys_context('USERENV','IP_ADDRESS') FROM dual; EXIT END_OF_SQL close TMP; my $msg = `sqlplus -L -S USER/PASSWORD\@hostname \@~tmp.sql`; print $msg; unlink '~tmp.sql'; poj
